mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID FROM INGEST_SYSTEM_DATASOURCE_REL r INNER JOIN INGEST_DATASOURCE d ON d.ID = r.DATASOURCE_ID AND d.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE r.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND d.DATASOURCE_NAME LIKE #{keyword}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM INGEST_SOURCE_SYSTEM WHERE CODE = #{code} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT DISTINCT SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID FROM INGEST_TASK WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM INGEST_TASK WHERE SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID = #{sourceId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID FROM INGEST_TASK WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID IN
#{id}

SELECT t.ID, t.CODE, t.NAME, t.TYPE, t.MODEL_ID, t.STATUS, latest.START_TIME AS LAST_RUN_TIME FROM INGEST_TASK t LEFT JOIN (SELECT TASK_ID, START_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TASK_ID ORDER BY START_TIME DESC, ID DESC) AS rn FROM INGEST_TASK_INSTANCE WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0') latest ON latest.TASK_ID = t.ID AND latest.rn = 1 WHERE t.SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID = #{sourceId} AND t.DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY t.CREATE_TIME DESC, t.ID DESC

SELECT USER_ID, COALESCE(NICK_NAME, USER_NAME) AS NAME, PHONENUMBER AS PHONE FROM SYSTEM_USER WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND USER_ID IN
#{id}

SELECT ID, CODE, NAME, ICON, RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID, DESCRIPTION, TRUST_SCORE, VALID_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATOR_ID, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATER_ID, UPDATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG, REMARK FROM INGEST_SOURCE_SYSTEM WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND ID IN
#{id}
